verdict.rationale: Raygun exposes token-authenticated APIs that suit CI automation: the Deployments API and dSYM, ProGuard and JS file uploads via an external access token (raygun-docs-8), plus source-map upload via API (raygun-docs-15). It also tracks deployments (raygun-docs-31) and has an official MCP server for programmatic access (raygun-probe-3). However, there is no documented CLI or CI pipeline integration, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD pipeline integrations (e.g. GitHub Actions), a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
